commentary: Headline index advances masking deteriorated breadth (score 40, gate WEAK) represent a classic distribution trap documented by Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil. When major indices forge ahead while underlying market breadth stagnates, institutional distribution routinely hides behind mega-cap support. Stage Analysis dictates that durable market thrust requires broad participation, not isolated index management. Traders must honor market direction discipline by reducing progressive exposure, enforcing tight trailing stops, and passing on unconfirmed breakouts. In an unconfirmed market tape, capital protection strictly supersedes aggressiveness.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.
